not_great_subtext.message: We have screwed up! Would you be so kind as to let us know how? Please email us at feedback@share-a-cart.com and tell us what happened. We'd love to fix it and reward you for pointing out an issue.

affil_disclosure_text.message: Share-A-Cart participates in affiliate programs with some of the retailers we support. This means we may earn a small commission when you use Share-A-Cart extension to "Create Cart ID" and "Receive Cart" on a supported retailer's website. Affiliate relationships do not influence which retailers we support, how the extension works, or the prices you pay.

receiving_cart_step_1_text.message: First, make sure to get the correct cart ID from your friend.

receiving_cart_step_2_text.message: Once you have it, click on the extension icon and press Receive Cart. In the 'Cart ID' field, type or paste the cart ID that your friend passed on to you, and when ready, click 'Get Cart'.

receiving_cart_step_3_text.message: Your friends cart will be retrieved, and retailer shopping cart page will open up. Presto!

review_thanks_subtext.message: We'd be eternally grateful if you can leave us a review as they really help us grow and keep Share-A-Cart free to use, forever.

sending_cart_step_1_text.message: First, shop on a supported retailer and place the items you would like to share into your cart. Don't forget to set the correct quantity as well.

sending_cart_step_2_text.message: Once, ready, click on the extension icon and press Create Cart ID. The contents of your cart will be packaged for delivery to whoever you want to send it to. Once packaged, you will see your cart's ID.

sending_cart_step_3_text.message: This is the ID that you need to pass to your friend. Simply IM, SMS, or email it to them!

support_text.message: Please remember that extensions sometimes break and take time to fix because of various store submission guidelines. If you encounter an issue with the extension, please reach out to feedback@share-a-cart.com for help.

supported_retailers_text.message: True to its name, Share-A-Cart browser addon supports a long and growing list of online retailers and grocers. The entirety of the list is available on $A_START$our website$A_END$.
